module_contract.path_validation: Reject relative/empty/root-relative paths, missing explicit extension and embedded NUL before loading. No implicit .dll filename append; caller supplies the audited installed absolute path.
module_contract.search_policy: Explicit filename; dependency filesystem search uses only its directory and System32, under normal Windows loader reuse/known-module rules. No bare-name filesystem search, process path mutation, alternate dependency/export or retry fallback.
module_contract.binding: Resolve all13 exact decorated names with GetProcAddress before construction publishes an owner. No zero/missing-export/default shim.
module_contract.publication: Noncopy/nonmove public owner; stable unique Impl stores module plus both tables. Only const references are exposed after successful construction.
module_contract.constructor_failure: Completed RAII BinkModule member releases only its own unescaped LoadLibrary reference if any later lookup/exception aborts Impl. No imported function or factory callback has been called by this owner. Errors name the path, missing export where applicable, and captured Win32 error.
module_contract.normal_teardown: Composition must close every real decoder handle, finish sound callback/native work and drain dependent shared/native owners before destroying the library. Its own LoadLibrary reference is then released once; dependent table members are destroyed first. No automatic decoder/sound cleanup is invented.
module_contract.interrupted_teardown: Retain the complete dependent runtime aggregate INCLUDING this library object/Impl, its stable import tables and module until process exit. A composing unique_ptr must retain/release the entire aggregate on an interrupted native path; do not unwind this library or keep only a copied table/HMODULE. The import owner has no handle census and cannot certify consumer teardown.
